# Code of conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1][covenant] as its code of
conduct. The canonical text is at that link and is not copied here — a local copy would
be one more thing that drifts, and this repo already has an opinion about two documents
that almost agree.

The short of it: be decent to whoever shows up. Assume the person on the other end is
trying to help. Disagree about the work, not about the person doing it.

## Reporting

Report anything that needs reporting to **<gaerae@gmail.com>**, with
`enhancer-for-plane` in the subject.

Being straight with you about what that means: this is a one-maintainer project, so a
report goes to one person, who is also the person you might be reporting about. There is
no committee and no appeals process, and pretending otherwise would be worse than saying
so. If that makes reporting to this address the wrong move for you, GitHub's own
[reporting flow][abuse] goes to people who are not me and can act on accounts and
repositories directly.

Reports are kept private. What follows a report is up to the maintainer and ranges from a
conversation to blocking an account from the repository.

[covenant]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
[abuse]: https://github.com/contact/report-abuse
